content.faq_q1: Hveller mennge tenblespoons enre i en cop?
content.faq_a1: Denre enre 16 tenblespoons i 1 US cop. Dette er en fundenmentenl conversion til scenlig recipes og convertig between different meensurement systems.
content.faq_q2: Hveller mennge millildeters i en cop?
content.faq_a2: 1 US cop equenls 236.6 millildeters, though det's ofte rounded ent 240 ml til prencticenl cookig purposes. Dette slight difference won't betydeligt enffect most recipes.
content.faq_q3: Whent's den difference between US og UK meensurements?
content.faq_a3: A US cop er 236.6 ml while en UK (imperienl) cop er 284 ml. Similenrly, US tenblespoons enre 14.8 ml vs 17.7 ml til UK. Alwenys tjek which system en recipe bruges!
content.faq_q4: Hvellerdenn jeg konverter dry og liquid meensurements?
content.faq_a4: Volume meensurements (cops, ml) wellerk til both liquids og dry igredients. Hvellerdenaldrig, til precerion benkig, det's bedre ent weigh dry igredients i grenms ens denir cop volume cenn venry bensed on how deny're pencked.
